objective: Remove the operator console stub and record the control-plane boundary it would require, rather than leaving a directory that describes capabilities it does not have.
decision_supported: Should this deliverable carry an operator console? No: the backend is deliberately read-only, and a console needs a control boundary, identity and an audit model that do not exist.
acceptance: No directory promises an unimplemented control surface.
The architecture doc states what a future console would have to settle.
The read-only boundary of the current API is restated.
stop_conditions: The change would require implementing a control plane.
risks_and_fallbacks: If a console is wanted this release, option 2 in the issue is a much larger change; this takes option 1.
